name: ModelVariant810_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant810_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (once each side's start time passes, a spinning Gouraud ring fan and a glow sprite follow a model point and leave a fading ribbon trail while a second ring fan and smoke puffs rise from another model point; when the side ends, a four-way burst fan and a flare flash in front of the slot while the ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, builds the ring, halo and burst fans and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the first start time, 4 once after the end time, 1 once on the following frame, 2 once the flare has faded after the light recovers and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-827 and 924 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
